feeds.title: Sever Bronny Blog
feeds.description: Sever Bronny is a coming of age / epic fantasy author. I grew up on Dragonlance, probably spending way too much time playing role-playing games, particularly Rifts and AD&D. Then came the video games, including Legend of Zelda, Doom, and Diablo. Much of my youth could easily be considered 'wasted' exploring virtual dungeons, but Nintendo was life in 1986 Toronto. Now I'm a full time author.
